content.value: Flexbox is optimized for one-dimensional layout: distributing space along one axis while controlling alignment and wrapping. It is ideal for nav bars, card rows, and component alignment before more complex two-dimensional systems like grid.

concepts.name: Flex container
concepts.description: An element whose children are laid out using the flexbox layout model.

concepts.name: Flex item
concepts.description: A direct child of a flex container participating in flex layout.

concepts.name: Main axis
concepts.description: The primary direction in which flex items are laid out.

concepts.name: Cross axis
concepts.description: The axis perpendicular to the flexbox main axis.

concepts.name: justify-content
concepts.description: A flexbox property that aligns items along the main axis.

concepts.name: align-items
concepts.description: A flexbox property that aligns items along the cross axis.
